options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: force_port
options.description: Allow ports that are already assigned to be re-assigned to your current host

options.name: group
options.description: The unique identifier of the host-group you want the host to be a member of; this is used for clustering.

options.name: host_type
options.description: This is the type of host to be mapped Required when C(state=present) Either one of the following names can be specified, Linux DM-MP, VMWare, Windows, Windows Clustered, or a host type index which can be found in M(netapp_eseries.santricity.netapp_e_facts)

options.name: log_path
options.description: A local path to a file to be used for debug logging

options.name: name
options.description: If the host doesn't yet exist, the label/name to assign at creation time. If the hosts already exists, this will be used to uniquely identify the host to make any required changes

options.name: ports
options.description: A list of host ports you wish to associate with the host. Host ports are uniquely identified by their WWN or IQN. Their assignments to a particular host are uniquely identified by a label and these must be unique.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Set to absent to remove an existing host Set to present to modify or create a new host definition
